name: step-list
title: Step list
description: How-to steps for docs: numbered markers on a hairline that ends after the last step, a real ordered list, and any content (text, code, images) inside each step.
docs: Numbers come from a CSS counter, so any content between steps keeps its place. start continues a guide, summaryOnly folds every step to its title for an overview, and a step with an id can be linked to. Pick the heading level of the titles with as.
